title: iPhone 15 charging port cleaning and cable check
diagnosis: Most often a no-charge fault on an iPhone 15 is lint packed into the USB-C port or a bad cable or adapter, so we'll rule those out first and clean the port. If it still won't charge, the port flex likely needs replacing, which is a harder job.
safety_notes: Never use metal pins or needles inside the port; they can short the contacts.
Stop and do not charge if the phone feels hot or the battery looks swollen.

steps.title: Unplug and power off
steps.instruction: Unplug any cable from the phone, remove the case, then hold the side button and a volume button and slide to power off.
steps.expected_visual_state: The screen is black, no cable is attached, and the case is off the phone.
common_mistakes: Leaving the cable plugged in while cleaning
Skipping power off so the phone stays live

steps.title: Inspect the port
steps.instruction: Shine a flashlight into the USB-C port at the bottom edge. Look for lint, dust or debris packed inside.
steps.expected_visual_state: The phone is held bottom-edge up with the flashlight beam lighting the port opening.
common_mistakes: Not looking with enough light and missing the lint
Mistaking the center tongue of the port for debris

steps.title: Clean out the port
steps.instruction: Gently scrape along the inside walls of the port with a wooden toothpick and lift out the lint. Do not press on the center tongue.
steps.expected_visual_state: A toothpick is in the port and small lint is visible on its tip or on the table.
common_mistakes: Using a metal pin that shorts or bends the contacts
Pushing lint deeper into the port

steps.title: Swap in a known-good cable and adapter
steps.instruction: Take a USB-C cable and power adapter you know work with another device. Plug them in firmly.
steps.expected_visual_state: A different cable is fully seated in the phone's port and connected to a wall adapter.
common_mistakes: Reusing the original possibly frayed cable
Using a loose or low-power adapter
Not pushing the plug in all the way

steps.title: Check for charging
steps.instruction: Wait a minute, then look at the screen for the charging indicator. If nothing, wait 15 minutes with the phone powered on.
steps.expected_visual_state: The screen shows the lightning-bolt battery icon or charging animation.
common_mistakes: Giving up after a few seconds on a fully drained battery
Charging on a wireless pad and thinking the port is fixed

steps.title: Test again with a second cable
steps.instruction: If it is still not charging, try a different wall outlet and a second cable. If it still fails, book a repair for the port flex.
steps.expected_visual_state: The phone shows the charging icon, or the phone is still dead and you have ruled out cable and adapter.
common_mistakes: Opening the phone without proper tools or replacement parts
